reason: The current baseline varies widely (878–1390 GFLOP/s), and the paired-load candidate lost in all three fresh comparisons. No proposal has a measured gain, so this order favors bounded changes that could reduce full-call work or scratch cost, then tests with larger locality or code-generation risks. `scratch_lifetime` directly targets allocation and scratch footprint, but its changed traversal also needs measurement. `streaming_region_cost` preserves the work order. Packing proposals rank lower because their copy and allocation costs may outweigh locality gains; the evidence gives no basis to assume they will help. Do not treat this ranking as a speed prediction or attribute a future joint result to one proposal.
